title: ardisia tahanica subsp. eucalyptifolia
intro: Ardisia tahanica subsp. eucalyptifolia, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the family Myrsinaceae, is native to Southeast Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Ardisia tahanica subsp. eucalyptifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help in reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antipyretic, analgesic, and expectorant activities.
